Severity.description: Ordinal severity, always derived from an explicit engine severity map (ENG-004). Variant order is the ordinal order — do not reorder (spec 2).

Confidence.description: Confidence in a Finding, ascending ordinal order (spec 8: Unconfirmed 0.50, Heuristic 0.70, Corroborated 0.85, Proven 1.00). Do not reorder.

FindingClass.description: The class of weakness a Finding describes; selects the identity tuple shape (spec 7.7.2).

NetworkImpact.description: Network impact of an Engine. Exactly two variants; a destructive variant MUST never be added — NG-1 is enforced by this type (ENG-001).

FindingStatus.description: Lifecycle status. Only a Complete engine outcome may transition a Finding to fixed (spec 7.7.4).

FindingId.description: blake3 of the identity tuple, truncated to 32 bytes, lowercase hex (spec 7.7.1). An identity, not a security primitive.
